combo_label: Things That Beep × At the Funfair × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Lord's estate with its hall, its mill and its villagers' scattered field strips
Hot kitchen cupboard that pings when the roast demands to come out.
Great tower at the heart of a stronghold, the last refuge once the walls were lost
Sticky red coating on a fairground apple
Engineer George whose giant wheel debuted at the 1893 Chicago fair
Hired singer who earned his supper retelling old heroics between courses
Loud-voiced tout drumming up a crowd for the next attraction
It chews your paper, jams, then beeps for help as if it were the victim.
Slim projection at a wall's corner, housing a lookout or a spiral stair
Drum ride that pins you to the wall as the floor drops away
Barrier arm that bleeps you through, or barks if your ticket is stale
Kitchen rumbler that clicks, chirps, and refuses to boil while you watch it.
